institutional.notes: Maximum 135 quarter credits toward an undergraduate degree; program rules apply. Virginia residents must complete at least 55 credits through Walden. Quarter credits must not be treated as semester credits.

ace.notes: Eligible ACE-approved prior learning and alternative courses may apply to undergraduate programs. Prior-learning categories have a combined 90-quarter-credit ceiling, within the overall 135-quarter-credit transfer ceiling. Exact course/competency applicability requires advisor confirmation.

nccrs.notes: Official policy includes portfolios recommended by NCCRS or Walden's Office of Degree Acceleration in the combined 90-quarter-credit prior-learning limit; this is not a blanket NCCRS course guarantee.

graduate.notes: Maximum varies by program and generally cannot exceed 50% of overall or embedded requirements, with specified nursing certificate exceptions. Internships, practica, dissertations, doctoral studies and theses are not transferable. Tempo maps eligible transferred courses to aligned competencies.
